purpose: Say that an action is optional.
keywords: ない-form → なくても + いい.
You do not have to come tomorrow.
You do not have to eat all of it.
You do not have to write your name.
formation: ない-form → なくても + いい.
restrictions: This removes an obligation; it does not prohibit the action.
mistake: Do not translate it as must not.
